title: SG-10.2.2 Scene applies the store's focusedObjectId as hover highlight and label
summary: BootScene reads focusedObjectId from the game store and applies the hover highlight and label to the matching object
description: Context: gameStore already exposes focusedObjectId and setFocusedObject (game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts). SceneObject already has focus() and blur() that show the same highlight and label as hover. BootScene.onStateChange (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) only calls sync(state) on each object and never reads focusedObjectId. Desired behavior: on every store change the scene focuses the object whose spec.id equals focusedObjectId and blurs all others, and clears focus on all objects when the value is null. Expected result: setting the store focus highlights and labels the matching object, and null clears them. Why: keyboard focus pushed into the store must be visible in the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given focusedObjectId is set to an existing visible object id, When the store changes, Then BootScene calls focus() on that SceneObject and blur() on every other focused object
Given focusedObjectId is null, When the store changes, Then no SceneObject is focused and focused objects are blurred
A unit test with Phaser mocked asserts both the highlight and label path (focus) and the clearing path (blur)

out_of_scope: Writing focusedObjectId from the keyboard handler

technical_constraints: Reuse SceneObject.focus() and blur(); do not add a second highlight path
Phaser 3.90 mocked in tests via vi.mock('phaser')
definition_of_done: Both requirements have passing unit tests
No regression in existing bootScene*.test.ts suites
